build_rl_trainer: build a BaseRLTrainer instance initialized with a Habitat config object for RL training
run_eval_checkpoint: run evaluation on a single checkpoint path using BaseRLTrainer._eval_checkpoint with a TensorboardWriter
run_eval_multiple: run evaluation across multiple checkpoints in a directory using BaseRLTrainer.eval with polling
setup_eval_config: setup a merged evaluation config from a checkpoint config and current eval config using _setup_eval_config
pause_envs_during_eval: pause environments and filter batch state during evaluation using BaseRLTrainer._pause_envs
